# VPS Comparison
> VPS comparison for Hostinger, Vultr, and DigitalOcean. Cheap 4 GB RAM on Hostinger intro pricing. Hourly billing on Vultr and DigitalOcean. Pick a region after you sign up.

## Start here
- [VPS Comparison 2026: Hostinger vs Vultr vs DigitalOcean](https://www.vpscomparison.com/): Homepage. Sign up for Hostinger, Vultr, or DigitalOcean first.
- [Best cheap VPS 2026](https://www.vpscomparison.com/guides/best-cheap-vps-2026/)
- [How to read VPS pricing](https://www.vpscomparison.com/blog/how-to-read-vps-pricing/): Intro rates vs hourly billing. 1 GB at $6 is not cheaper than 4 GB at $4.99.
